name: Memory (LanceDB Pro)
description: Enhanced LanceDB-backed long-term memory with hybrid retrieval, multi-scope isolation, and management CLI

taskQuery.description: Embedding task for queries (provider-specific, e.g. Jina: retrieval.query)

taskPassage.description: Embedding task for passages/documents (provider-specific, e.g. Jina: retrieval.passage)

normalized.description: Request normalized embeddings when supported by the provider (e.g. Jina v5)

enableManagementTools.description: Enable memory_list and memory_stats management tools

rerankApiKey.description: API key for reranker service (enables cross-encoder reranking)

rerankEndpoint.description: Reranker API endpoint URL. Compatible with Jina, SiliconFlow, Pinecone, or any service with a similar interface.

rerankProvider.description: Reranker provider format. Determines request/response shape and auth header.

recencyHalfLifeDays.description: Half-life in days for recency boost. Newer memories get higher scores. Set 0 to disable.

recencyWeight.description: Maximum recency boost factor added to score

filterNoise.description: Filter out noise memories (agent denials, meta-questions, boilerplate)

lengthNormAnchor.description: Length normalization anchor in chars. Entries longer than this get score penalized. Set 0 to disable.

hardMinScore.description: Hard cutoff after all scoring stages. Results below this score are discarded.

timeDecayHalfLifeDays.description: Time decay half-life in days. Old entries lose score gradually. Floor at 0.5x. Set 0 to disable.

enabled.description: Store session summaries to LanceDB on /new command (replaces built-in session-memory hook)

messageCount.description: Number of recent messages to include in session summary

enabled.description: TM1 (total-memory): store every turn pair as a low-importance observation in a dedicated scope so no fact is silently lost

importance.description: Importance assigned to observation entries (kept low so curated memories outrank raw turns)

retentionDays.description: Observations older than this are expired by the daily maintenance pass

dedupThreshold.description: Vector similarity above which a new observation is considered a duplicate and skipped

maxTextLength.description: Hard cap on stored observation text length (characters)

enabled.description: TM2 (total-memory): before compaction summarizes history away, sweep it for missed turn pairs (to observation scope) and trigger-matched facts (to default scope)

maxPairs.description: Max turn pairs swept per compaction, oldest first (each costs one embedding call)

maxFacts.description: Max trigger-matched facts stored per compaction

enabled.description: TM3 (total-memory): warm a per-session retrieval cache after each turn and serve recall from it instantly when the next query is similar

similarityGate.description: Cosine similarity (incoming query vs prefetched query) required to serve cached recall; below it falls back to live retrieval

liveRerankTimeoutMs.description: Rerank API timeout for the live-fallback path (background prefetch keeps 5000ms)

ttlMinutes.description: Prefetched results expire after this many minutes

maxSessions.description: Max concurrent sessions kept in the prefetch cache (oldest evicted)

enabled.description: TM4 (total-memory): verbatim full-text search over session transcripts via an SQLite FTS5 sidecar (session_search tool + memx sessions CLI)

maxResults.description: Default result limit for the session_search tool

maxMessageLength.description: Max characters of one message stored in the index

enabled.description: TM5 (total-memory): neutralize prompt-injection patterns (instruction override, role hijack, prompt exfiltration, tag injection) before any text is stored to memory

egressGuard.description: Gate outbound sends to destinations the owner has not vouched for. Recalled memories sit in context on every turn, so an injected instruction could exfiltrate them via a send tool.

mode.description: approve = ask the owner; block = refuse; log = observe only

allowedTargets.description: Destinations that never need approval: chat ids, emails, or *@domain.com

extraSendTools.description: Extra tool-name substrings to treat as outbound sends

embedding.apiKey.label: API Key
embedding.apiKey.help: API key for the embedding provider (or use ${OPENAI_API_KEY}; use a dummy value for keyless local endpoints)

embedding.model.label: Embedding Model
embedding.model.help: Embedding model name (e.g. text-embedding-3-small, gemini-embedding-001, nomic-embed-text)

embedding.baseURL.label: Base URL
embedding.baseURL.help: Custom base URL for OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoints (e.g. https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/ for Gemini, http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama)

embedding.dimensions.label: Vector Dimensions
embedding.dimensions.help: Override vector dimensions for custom models not in the built-in lookup table

dbPath.label: Database Path
dbPath.help: Directory path for the LanceDB database files

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically capture important information from conversations

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories into context

captureAssistant.label: Capture Assistant Messages
captureAssistant.help: Also auto-capture assistant messages (default false to reduce memory pollution)

retrieval.mode.label: Retrieval Mode
retrieval.mode.help: Use hybrid search (vector + BM25) or vector-only for backward compatibility

retrieval.vectorWeight.label: Vector Search Weight
retrieval.vectorWeight.help: Weight for vector similarity in hybrid search (0-1)

retrieval.bm25Weight.label: BM25 Search Weight
retrieval.bm25Weight.help: Weight for BM25 keyword search in hybrid search (0-1)

retrieval.minScore.label: Minimum Score Threshold
retrieval.minScore.help: Drop results below this relevance score (0-1)

retrieval.rerank.label: Reranking Mode
retrieval.rerank.help: Re-score fused results for better quality (cross-encoder uses configured reranker API)

retrieval.rerankApiKey.label: Reranker API Key
retrieval.rerankApiKey.help: Reranker API key for cross-encoder reranking

retrieval.rerankProvider.label: Reranker Provider
retrieval.rerankProvider.help: Provider format: jina (default), siliconflow, or pinecone

retrieval.candidatePoolSize.label: Candidate Pool Size
retrieval.candidatePoolSize.help: Number of candidates to fetch before fusion and reranking

sessionMemory.enabled.label: Session Memory
sessionMemory.enabled.help: Store session summaries to LanceDB when /new is triggered (replaces built-in session-memory hook)

sessionMemory.messageCount.label: Session Message Count
sessionMemory.messageCount.help: Number of recent messages to include in session summaries

scopes.default.label: Default Scope
scopes.default.help: Default memory scope for new memories

scopes.definitions.label: Scope Definitions
scopes.definitions.help: Define custom memory scopes with descriptions

scopes.agentAccess.label: Agent Access Control
scopes.agentAccess.help: Define which scopes each agent can access

enableManagementTools.label: Management Tools
enableManagementTools.help: Enable memory_list and memory_stats tools for debugging and auditing

retrieval.lengthNormAnchor.label: Length Normalization Anchor
retrieval.lengthNormAnchor.help: Entries longer than this (chars) get score penalized to prevent long entries dominating. 0 = disabled.

retrieval.hardMinScore.label: Hard Minimum Score
retrieval.hardMinScore.help: Discard results below this score after all scoring stages. Higher = fewer but more relevant results.

retrieval.timeDecayHalfLifeDays.label: Time Decay Half-Life
retrieval.timeDecayHalfLifeDays.help: Old entries lose score over this many days. Floor at 0.5x. 0 = disabled.

embedding.taskQuery.label: Query Task
embedding.taskQuery.help: Optional task selector for query embeddings (Jina: retrieval.query). If unset, no task field is sent.

embedding.taskPassage.label: Passage Task
embedding.taskPassage.help: Optional task selector for passage/document embeddings (Jina: retrieval.passage). If unset, no task field is sent.

embedding.normalized.label: Normalized Embeddings
embedding.normalized.help: Request normalized embeddings when the provider supports it (Jina v5). If unset, the field is not sent.

observations.enabled.label: Observation Layer (TM1)
observations.enabled.help: Store every turn pair as a low-importance observation so no fact is silently lost; promoted/expired by nightly maintenance

observations.importance.label: Observation Importance
observations.importance.help: Importance assigned to observation entries (low keeps curated memories ranked above raw turns)

observations.retentionDays.label: Observation Retention (days)
observations.retentionDays.help: Observations older than this are deleted by the daily maintenance pass

observations.dedupThreshold.label: Observation Dedup Threshold
observations.dedupThreshold.help: Vector similarity above which a new observation is skipped as a duplicate

observations.maxTextLength.label: Observation Max Length
observations.maxTextLength.help: Hard cap on stored observation text (characters)

compactionExtract.enabled.label: Pre-compaction Extraction (TM2)
compactionExtract.enabled.help: Harvest history into memory before compaction destroys it

compactionExtract.maxPairs.label: Compaction Sweep Max Pairs
compactionExtract.maxPairs.help: Max turn pairs swept per compaction (oldest first)

compactionExtract.maxFacts.label: Compaction Sweep Max Facts
compactionExtract.maxFacts.help: Max trigger-matched facts stored per compaction

prefetch.enabled.label: Prefetch Recall (TM3)
prefetch.enabled.help: Serve memory recall from a cache warmed after the previous turn — near-zero recall latency in ongoing conversations

prefetch.similarityGate.label: Prefetch Similarity Gate
prefetch.similarityGate.help: How close the new query must be to the prefetched one to use the cache

prefetch.liveRerankTimeoutMs.label: Live Rerank Timeout (ms)
prefetch.liveRerankTimeoutMs.help: Rerank timeout when falling back to live retrieval

sessionSearch.enabled.label: Session Search (TM4)
sessionSearch.enabled.help: Verbatim transcript search — exact quotes, names, numbers, dates

threatScan.enabled.label: Store-time Threat Scan (TM5)
threatScan.enabled.help: Block injection-style instructions from entering long-term memory

egressGuard.label: Memory Egress Guard
egressGuard.help: Requires approval before the agent sends to a destination you have not vouched for — the main defence against prompt-injection exfiltration of recalled memories.

allowedTargets.label: Vouched destinations
allowedTargets.help: Chat ids, email addresses, or *@domain.com wildcards
